Animal Life - Australia.name: Animal Life: Australia
Animal Life - Australia.summary: Explore the wildlife of Australia in this educational game for the Nintendo DS. Solve puzzles, learn animal facts, and collect stars to become an expert on Australian fauna. Features DSi camera support and progressive unlockable content.

Bibi Blocksberg - Neustadt im Hex-Chaos.name: Bibi Blocksberg: Neustadt im Hex-Chaos
Bibi Blocksberg - Neustadt im Hex-Chaos.summary: Young witch Schubia Wanzhaar turns Neustadt upside down! From Aunt Mania's witch book, she tried out a very special spell that was forbidden and caused a huge chaos in the whole city. Great fun for Schubia, a nightmare for the citizens of Neustadt. And everyone thinks Bibi Blocksberg is the culprit. Now it's up to you: slip into the role of Bibi and uncover the error! To do this, you must try to undo the whole mess.

Brain Voyage.name: Brain Voyage
Brain Voyage.summary: Brain Voyage features the famous German board game designer Dr. Reiner Knizia. He guides the player on a world tour through 13 different cities and explains how every puzzle works.

Call of Duty - World at War.name: Call of Duty: World at War
Call of Duty - World at War.summary: Call of Duty: World at War is a first person shooter created as a Nintendo DS version of Call of Duty: World at War. Although being very similar to it in a visual aspect, being developed by the same designers, it features many changes, including an improved game engine, better AI, the addition of minigames, anve, Unlike the console versions, there is no Zombies mode.

Imagine - Teacher - Class Trip.name: Imagine: Teacher - Class Trip
Imagine - Teacher - Class Trip.summary: A camping centred mini game collection developed by Magic Pockets and published by Ubisoft.

Learn with Pokemon - Typing Adventure.name: Learn with Pokémon: Typing Adventure
Learn with Pokemon - Typing Adventure.summary: A Pokémon-themed typing game where players type words that appear on-screen to defeat Pokémon. It comes packaged with a wireless keyboard.

Legend of the Guardians - The Owls of Ga.name: Legend of the Guardians: The Owls of Ga'Hoole
Legend of the Guardians - The Owls of Ga.summary: A companion game to the upcoming Legend of the Guardians: The Owls of Ga'Hoole theatrical release, this videogame will take players on an amazing adventure as they customize their very own Guardian owl and experience an airborne adventure like never before. Take on the role of a young Guardian and set out on a secret mission to uncover a new threat to the owl kingdom. Fly, race, fight off enemies, string together combos, and battle epic bosses throughout the mystical and magical world of Ga'Hoole.

Lionel Trains - On Track.name: Lionel Trains: On Track
Lionel Trains - On Track.summary: The gameplay of Lionel Trains: On Track is very similar to Sid Meier's Railroad Tycoon series of computer games. In the game, you are the head of an unspecified railroad, and your objective is to connect different cities together through rail, using the funds you start off with, and later earn. There are several separate modes of gameplay, with varying objectives.

Mega Man Star Force 2 - Zerker x Ninja.name: Mega Man Star Force 2: Zerker x Ninja
Mega Man Star Force 2 - Zerker x Ninja.summary: Mega Man Star Force 2 blends a unique formula of RPG exploration elements with fast-paced action, as players travel and battle between coexisting worlds, the physical world and the virtual Wave World, to unravel the mystery around this new troublemaker.

Pet Pals - Animal Doctor.name: Pet Pals: Animal Doctor
Pet Pals - Animal Doctor.summary:
Give your favorite animals the tender loving care they need to nurse them back to health. 
 
 
You are the animal doctor at a busy veterinarian clinic and will need nurse all the animals back to health! The unique Wii Remote simulates real veterinary tools as you use them to treat 30 different cases, ranging from minor cases like sunburn, lacerations and infections to more serious problems like diabetes, tumors and snakebites.

Powershot Pinball Constructor.name: Powershot Pinball Constructor
Powershot Pinball Constructor.summary:
Play against friends or alone on a selection of stylish tables.

Engage Sabotage Mode to disrupt your opponent's game. Compete in team battle or time attack and discover secret areas and mini games. Create your dream table using the first Nintendo DS pinball table editor and share it with your friends.

Rhythm Heaven.name: Rhythm Heaven
Rhythm Heaven.summary: Rhythm Heaven puts the music in your hands and some rhythm in your life. Let the music move you as you tap and slide your stylus on the touch screen to the beat of more than 50 musical rhythm games. The controls are as natural as tapping your finger to music.

Rockin' Pretty.name: Rockin' Pretty
Rockin' Pretty.summary: Get your groove on with Rockin' Pretty, a music rhythm game starring four teenage girls trying to make it as rock stars. Select one of four instruments, including lead guitar, bass, keyboard, or drums, and then use your stylus to tap or strum on the touch screen in time to the beat. Earn applause and "stars" after each successful performance and move one step closer to fame and fortune. Accumulated stars can also be used to unlock additional clothing options, hairstyles, and instruments for personal use or to trade with others via wireless connection.

Rosario to Vampire - Tanabata no Miss Yo.name: Rosario + Vampire: Tanabata no Miss Yokai Gakuen
Rosario to Vampire - Tanabata no Miss Yo.summary: A Capcom developed adventure game released exclusively for Nintendo DS systems in Japan

Theresia...name: Theresia
Theresia...summary:
Theresia is a horror / visual novel hybrid which is split into two campaigns; Dear Emile and Dear Martel.

Dear Emile - A tale of twisted love between a mother and her daughter. Snatched from the jaws of death by a woman who reeked of blood, Leanne has grown up in a world of torture, war, and death. Now a young woman, she finds herself in a deadly labyrinth with no memories of her past. Can she uncover the truth behind her imprisonment and escape with her life, or will Leanne be doomed to wander the halls of her prison, haunted by the mystery of Theresia?

Dear Martel - When a fever ravaged his orphanage, a brilliant doctor developed a treatment for the disease, hoping to save the children in his care. Though the fever was defeated, from its corpse rose something far more deadly something far more evil. Will he be able to atone for his mistake, or will his creation spell certain doom for mankind?
